Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Ajeet Kumar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Ajeet Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Manoj Kumar Sahu, learned
A.G.A. for the State and perused the records.

2.  The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
460 of 2020, under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC, 3/4 POCSO Act & 3(2)(v)a, 3(2)(V) SC/ST Act,
Police Station Manjhila, District Hardoi.
3.
The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 13.11.2020 alleging that the applicant had enticed away the informants minor daughter on 10.11.2020.
4. In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. she has stated that she loves the applicant.
5. In the medico legal examination report of the victim, her age has been opined to be 19 years and Sonu Sharma vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. ...

no mark of injury or sign of use of force has been reported on any part of her body.
6. In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. also, she stated that she loves the applicant.
However, she stated that the applicant made physical relations with her forcibly.
7. In the affidavit filed in support of bail application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.

8. In the counter affidavit, it has been stated that the applicant is involved in another case bearing Case Crime No. 48 of 2020, under Section 354-kha, 504, 506 IPC and 3(1)Dha, 3(2)Va SC/ST Act,
Police Station Manjhila, District Hardoi.
In the rejoinder affidavit, it has been stated that no charge sheet has been filed in the aforesaid case till date.
9. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

10. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the victim is opined to be major in her medico legal examination and she has consistently stated that she loves the applicant; that the victim has stated that the applicant made physical relations with her forcibly. This fact is, prima facie, not supported by the medico legal examination report,
coupled with the fact that the applicant is languishing in jail since 18.11.2020 and without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
11. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.
